stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $\mathcal{F}$ be a sheaf of sets on the topological space $X$.
For every open $U \subset X$ the map
$$
\mathcal{F}(U)
\longrightarrow
\prod\nolimits_{x \in U} \mathcal{F}_x
$$
is injective.

reason: The proof turns equality of all section germs into an open cover on which the two sections agree and invokes sheaf uniqueness to conclude injectivity.
